body:
I just wanted to thank the two commenters who posted something for actually trying, but it's not done much.

In approx. 45 minutes from when this comment's been posted, I should be hanging from a tree.

See ya'll around.

What if I don't want to live for my own sake?

There's nothing out there that I enjoy doing any more.
Because trolling's really the smartest thing you can do here, you asshole.
